verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is an LLM routing/API aggregation product; the evidence covers model routing, fallbacks, caching, budgets, and key management, but there is no mention of user-defined rule/trigger-based automation (e.g., 'if X happens, do Y' event-driven workflows). Workspace budgets automatically blocking requests is the closest analog but is a single fixed built-in behavior, not a user-defined rules engine.
